issues.quote: six hundred nineteen point zero million dollars
issues.problem: This is off by a factor of 1,000. Microsoft's total assets at the end of fiscal 2025 were about $619.0 billion, not $619.0 million.

data.summary: Most of the figures match Microsoft's fiscal 2025 results as I know them. Revenue was $281.7B, up 14.9% from $245.1B. Net income was $101.8B, operating income was $128.5B, and cash and cash equivalents were $30.2B. One figure is wrong: total assets were about $619.0 billion, but the text says million.
